items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...by Hudson Marquez in the living room of Roy Bird's home...

ctx.x: This conversation with Roy, Professor Longhair Bird, was taped in New Orleans on May 30th, 1969, by Hudson Marquez in the living room of Roy Bird's home at 1522 South Rampart Street. See Calvin Brown.
